# dsh-expert-ai
English | 中文
`dsh-expert-ai` keeps a library of expert identities (persona, avatar, source disclosure) for DeepSe
ek Harness and serves it to other plugins through the `expertIdentity` Cordis service. It is the ide
ntity layer meant to run together with the `dsh-bot` runtime, and it adds exactly one other thing: a
conversation with a single expert.
## Features
The plugin does two things:
- **Identity layer**: persists records in the `expert-ai` settings namespace and each identity in `$
DSH_HOME/expert-ai/<id>/agents/<id>.md`; provides the `expertIdentity` Cordis service so another plu
gin, such as a Bot runtime, can read the enabled identities: persona, avatar, source disclosure and

revision.
- **Single-expert conversation**: pick an expert in the sidebar Chat Panel to open a conve
rsation bound to that expert's persona. It has no Workspace, is forced to the read-only file sandbox

, and gets its opening message from the plugin.
- **Expert mention and consultation**: `@<id>` and `
@<name>` in the composer save the mention as model-visible text, and the primary agent can ask one e
xpert through the `consult_expert` tool, whose answer comes back through a persona subagent.
It also adds a Harness-styled settings section for creating, editing, enabling, and deleting records
, with imports from agent Markdown files (YAML frontmatter is ignored, the body is the persona) or v
ersioned `mimeographs` method packages.
It does not add an Agent preset selector or group chats (the `dsh-bot` runtime owns those).
## Working with dsh-bot
This plugin only supplies identities; the `dsh-bot` runtime runs the single and group chats. Install
both into the same Profile.
- `dsh-bot` asks for the `expertIdentity` service with `ctx.inject(['expertIdentity'], …)`. Without

this plugin it behaves like a plain ds-bot, and this plugin needs nothing from `dsh-bot`.
- Identiti
es are created and edited only here, under **Settings → 专家**. `dsh-bot` is designed to take a bound

Bot's persona and source disclosure from the service and to follow `expert-identity/changed`.
- This
plugin registers no session tools and binds no persona to Harness's own Sessions, so a Bot Session

carries one identity.
- A linked checkout is served from `lib/`, which is not committed: run `pnpm r
un build` after changing the Host half.
The split of responsibilities and the service contract are in `docs/expert-bot-phase1.md`.
## Demo
| Chat Panel | Settings | Create expert |
## Record fields
Each record has an `id`, `name`, `description`, primary-domain `category`, composable `tags[]`, `ori
gin`, `persona`, and `enabled` flag. Metadata (name, title, description, tags, source, avatar) lives
only in the record; `origin` says where the identity body is read from:
| `origin.kind` | Body comes from | Editable |
| `managed` | `$DSH_HOME/expert-ai/<id>/agents/<id>.md`, written from `persona` when the settings pa

ge saves | Yes |
| `file` | The Host Markdown file at `origin.path` (`~`, absolute, or relative to `

$DSH_HOME/expert-ai/`) | No, the file is the source |
| `bundled` | A pack directory inside the plug
in package, such as `experts/ELON` or `experts/xingtu/clq`; any nesting is allowed | No; **Copy as m

anaged identity** in settings |
| `package` | An imported pack under `$DSH_HOME/expert-ai/mimeograph
s/<slug>/` | No; can be copied as managed |
Bundled experts and imported method packs share one pack format: `manifest.json` (`schemaVersion: 2`
, initial metadata, provenance and the sha256 of every file), `AGENTS.md` (the body, no frontmatter)
, and optional `SKILL.md`, `LICENSE` and `references/*.md`. Sizes and hashes are verified before a p
al `SKILL.md`, `LICENSE` and `references/*.md`. Sizes and hashes are verified before a pack is read.
`toolFilter` and `model` are optional: `toolFilter` limits the tools of both the chat and a consulta
tion, while `model` (provider/model) applies to `consult_expert` only. New records using the `custom
` category should set `customCategory`; without it the display name is used.
Older records with `agent`, `expertPackage` or `tag` still load: the Host derives `origin` from them
, and the settings page writes the new shape on its next save. Leftover `features`, `teams`, `maxBat
chSize` and `provider` are ignored.
Presentation fields are optional, so records saved before they existed stay valid:

- `title` (at most 40 characters after trimming) is shown after the name and defaults to “Bot”.
- `a
vatar` is `{ mime, data }` with an `image/png`, `image/jpeg` or `image/webp` mime and base64 data; t
he whole data URL must fit in 160,000 characters. The editor crops a picked image to a centered 160

px square and re-encodes it.
[该节后续省略]
## expertIdentity service
Another plugin reads identities with `ctx.inject(['expertIdentity'], ctx => …)`:
- `list()` returns the enabled identities whose persona can be read. `get(id)` returns one with its

`persona` and `disclosure`, or `undefined` for an unknown, disabled or unreadable id.
- Every identi

ty carries `origin` (`managed`, `file`, `bundled` or `package`); older consumers may ignore it.

### Prerequisites

- A working DeepSeek Harness checkout
- Node.js and pnpm versions supported by that Harness checkout
- A GitHub URL for this repository
## Known Limitations
- The Chat Panel starts expert conversations in a new Session each time. The `@` menu inserts mentio

n text in the current Session without creating or opening another Session.
- A chat cannot switch mo
dels per record: the Session model selection DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 offers plugins also rewrites the deploym

ent default, so `model` applies to `consult_expert` only.
- A same-named file in the data directory

no longer overrides a bundled expert; use **Copy as managed identity** to edit one.
- The Chat Panel
lives in the sidebar footer action Slot: the current public sidebar has no additive Slot above the

workspace browser.
- Expert conversations use the deployment's default Agent preset; the plugin no l
onger installs one of its own.
